system_overview: This is a model-checking configuration module for the Yo-Yo leader election algorithm with pruning. It instantiates the pruning variant of the algorithm with a concrete five-node graph, enabling exhaustive verification of termination and correctness properties.
actors_and_components: The module defines five nodes (integers one through five) connected by the same edge set as the non-pruning model-checking module. It instantiates the Yo-Yo algorithm with pruning, which includes node activation tracking and edge pruning during the upward phase.
state_variables: All state variables are inherited from the pruning specification: each node's activation flag, phase, incoming and outgoing neighbor sets, and mailbox.
initial_state: Inherited from the pruning specification with the concrete five-node graph.
actions: All actions are inherited from the pruning specification: downward broadcasting, minimum forwarding, upward replies with prune flags, edge reversal, edge pruning, and node deactivation.
safety_properties: The configuration checks type correctness, a neighbor consistency invariant, and a property that deadlock occurs if and only if the termination condition is met. The no-new-source property is commented out because it fails for the small example graph due to pruning effects.
liveness_properties: The configuration checks that the algorithm eventually terminates: the minimum-identity node becomes the leader, all other nodes become inactive, and all mailboxes are empty.
model_bounds: Five nodes (integers one through five) with edges connecting: nodes one and two, nodes one and five, nodes three and four, nodes three and five, and nodes four and five. Deadlock checking is disabled. An alternative larger graph with eleven nodes is included as a comment.
additional_assumptions: The module declares the five state variables from the pruning specification (including the activation variable) and uses module instantiation to import all definitions. The chosen graph ensures the pruning algorithm can be tested for termination.
